title: DREAM Live-NPC Memory Artifact v1
description: Read-optimized NPC memory snapshot assembled at wake time. Holds current zone, sentiment, and recent episodic history. Written back after each encounter via memory-writeback.v1 batch. Supports read/write round-trip <2s for T1 NPCs.

kind.description: Discriminator so loaders can branch on artifact type.

zone.description: Last known zone/location id. Format: 'zone.<region>.<sub>'. Example: 'zone.harbor.pier'.

last_seen.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the NPC's most recent player encounter or wake.

sentiment.description: Current mood offset from persona baseline. -1=hostile, 0=neutral/baseline, +1=elated. Persisted across wakes; decays toward 0 over time.

history.description: Top-k episodic memories by salience (k<=8). Assembled from the episodic vector store at wake time — NOT a full dump. Ordered descending by effective salience (salience * decay_factor).

memory_id.description: Unique episodic row id. Format: 'mem_<hex4>'. Example: 'mem_e1a9'.

ts.description: When the event occurred (game time, UTC).

event.description: Short snake-case slug or prose describing what happened. No PII. Example: 'player_asked_about_pier_work'.

actors.description: Game-scoped ids of participants. Format: 'ply_<id>' or 'npc.<name>.<role>'.

salience.description: Original recall weight at write time.

location_id.description: Zone where the event happened. Optional.

tags.description: Free tags for filtering and prompt assembly. Example: ['first_contact','work'].

relationships.description: Relationship rows for players relevant to this wake. Optional — omitted when no prior relationship exists.

last_seen_ts.description: Last encounter timestamp with this player.

context_refs.description: Pointer set assembled by the orchestrator for lazy-loading additional context (persona core, extra episodic queries). Present when assembling a wake body; may be omitted in storage form.
